info.name: 14 - Revenues
info.description: Endpoints to manage gym revenue records (membership fees, services, and other income).

request.description:
### Endpoint Overview

Fetches a paginated list of revenue records for the current gym with dynamic sorting and filtering.

---

### Available Domain Attributes & Filter Reference

| Attribute Name | Data Type | Filter Support | Description / Allowed Values |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `Id` | `int` | Exact | Unique Identifier |
| `GymId` | `int` | Exact | Associated Gym ID |
| `RevenueCategory` | `Enum (int)` | Exact | `0` = MembershipFee, `1` = PersonalTraining, `2` = Merchandise, `3` = Other |
| `GymMemberId` | `int?` | Exact | Associated gym person ID of the member |
| `Amount` | `decimal` | Between | Revenue amount |
| `PaymentMethod` | `Enum (int)` | Exact | `0` = Cash, `1` = CreditCard, `2` = DebitCard, `3` = BankTransfer, `4` = Online, `5` = Other |
| `ReferenceNumber` | `string` | Searchable | Payment reference number |
| `Description` | `string` | - | Optional description |
| `RevenueDate` | `DateTime` | Between | ISO format revenue date |
| `CreatedOn` | `DateTime` | Between | ISO creation date |
| `CreatedById` | `int` | Exact | Creator ID |

---

### Filter Usage Guide (For Request Body)

- **Exact Filters (`exactFilters`):** Pass attribute name with array of string/enum values. Example: `"exactFilters": { "RevenueCategory": ["0"] }`
- **Between Filters (`betweenFilters`):** Pass attribute name with `min` and `max`. Example: `"betweenFilters": { "RevenueDate": { "min": "2026-01-01", "max": "2026-12-31" } }`

---

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner` or `Manager`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Fetches a single revenue record by ID.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner` or `Manager`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Records a new revenue entry for the current gym.

### Request Fields (`RevenueCDTO`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `revenueCategory` | `Enum (int)` | Yes | `0` = MembershipFee, `1` = PersonalTraining, `2` = Merchandise, `3` = Other |
| `gymMemberId` | `int?` | No | Gym person ID of the member (must belong to the gym) |
| `amount` | `decimal` | Yes | Must be greater than zero |
| `paymentMethod` | `Enum (int)` | Yes | `0` = Cash, `1` = CreditCard, `2` = DebitCard, `3` = BankTransfer, `4` = Online, `5` = Other |
| `referenceNumber` | `string?` | No | Max 100 characters |
| `description` | `string?` | No | Max 500 characters |
| `revenueDate` | `DateTime` | Yes | ISO format date |

Returns `201 Created` with `Result<RevenueRDTO>`.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner` or `Manager`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Updates an existing revenue record by ID.

### Request Fields (`RevenueUDTO`)

Same fields as Create: `revenueCategory`, `gymMemberId`, `amount`, `paymentMethod`, `referenceNumber`, `description`, `revenueDate`.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner` or `Manager`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Soft-deletes a revenue record by ID.
